'''Mistress Grinwell''' is a farmer's wife who lives between [[Whitebridge]] and [[Caemlyn]].

==History==

She is the mother of nine children, the eldest being [[Else Grinwell]].

==Activities==

When [[Master Grinwell]] shelters [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Matrim Cauthon]], who are are on their way to Caemlyn, in exchange for work in the farm, she gives them clothes. She is very observant of her guests. She convinces her husband to give them Else's room instead of the barn for the night.

At night, Rand and Mat play with [[Thom|Thom's]] instruments for the family.{{ref/book|1|31}}

== In the television series ==
* In the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|TV series]], {{TVlink|Mistress Grinwell}} is played by actress {{TVlink|Jennifer Preston}}.
